article_science_rain.summary: Rain is old water that has taken a long trip. Water from rivers, lakes and puddles rises into the air, cools, gathers into clouds, and falls back down as drops. After reading this you can explain where rain comes from, name the three steps of the water cycle, and tell the difference between rain, drizzle, snow and hail.
article_science_rain.title: Where Does Rain Come From?
